d:
Oscar and Grammy winner Jamie Foxx is joined by his daughter Corinne Foxx to discuss his Netflix special, Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was... at FYSEE LA: Comedy Night, a star-studded celebration of Netflix’s stand-up. Hosted by Fortune Feimster (NIAJ Radio’s “What a Joke”), this dynamic event showcased some of the biggest names in comedy:
Emmy winner Sarah Silverman, Emmy nominee Mike Birbiglia, Critics Choice winner Michelle Buteau, Bert Kreischer, Fortune Feimster, Tom Segura, Andrew Schulz.
